name: External title source-brand and style-cue masking sensitivity
target: prediction of supplied corpus labels from normalized title text
model: fixed word-unigram TF-IDF plus Linear SVM, C=1

source_brand_lexicon.eligibility: A normalized hostname must occur in at least 10 cleaned records in the corresponding external corpus.
source_brand_lexicon.matching: Distinctive publisher/platform aliases are matched as complete normalized token sequences.

conditions: Locked model on original external titles
Locked model after external source-brand masking
Locked model after external style-phrase masking
Locked model after combined external masking
Combined masking applied symmetrically before ISOT refitting and external evaluation

uncertainty.status: marginal descriptive 95% intervals; no simultaneous coverage claim

hypothesis_testing: No new null-hypothesis tests are added to the 19-test multiplicity family.
interpretation_limits: The analysis was added after review and is not confirmatory.
The lexicon may miss indirect self-reference, abbreviations, or source names absent from supplied URLs.
Some distinctive aliases may occasionally be used non-editorially.
Masking uses target-corpus hostname metadata but not target labels.
Explicit string removal cannot eliminate distributed syntax, topic, or source-associated writing style.
